name: Ghost
source: Pathfinder Monster Core, Ghost (pg. 160), via Archives of Nethys: https://2e.aonprd.com/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=418
license: ORC License: Paizo's Pathfinder Monster Core is ORC licensed material.
rules: For a living creature. Increase its level by 2; AC, saves, Perception, DCs, skills and attacks by 2; its best melee Strike becomes a ghostly hand (+4 in all, void damage, agile, finesse, magical). Strength -5, Constitution +0; HP unchanged. Becomes an incorporeal undead ghost: darkvision, Site Bound, rejuvenation, void healing, immunities, resistance to all damage, a fly Speed in place of its Speed, and one to three special abilities.
optional: Unholy: many ghosts are; remove it if not. Its HP stay as they were. Its other Strikes stay (+2): a ghost's weapons are ghostly memories, so remove any that don't fit. It loses abilities and traits that rely on a living, corporeal body: remove those by hand, and adjust abilities that conflict with its theme. Site Bound: a typical limit is 120 feet; some ghosts are bound to a room, building, item or creature instead. Rejuvenation: Paizo's ghosts name what lets this one rest.

resistances.suffix: (except force, _ghost touch_, spirit, or vitality; double resistance vs. non-magical)

choices.label: Special abilities
choices.note: One or two that relate to its death or history, or three at 9th level or higher; or make your own.

choices.label: Write out the abilities' rules text
choices.note: Off: Site Bound named only, as Paizo prints ghosts (the rules are with the Ghost family in Monster Core). On: with its text.

abilities.name: Site Bound
abilities.description: {Name} can stray only a short distance from where it was killed or the place it haunts. A typical limit is 120 feet. Some ghosts are instead bound to a room, building, item, or creature that was special to them rather than a location.

abilities.name: Rejuvenation
abilities.description: When {name} is destroyed, it re-forms after 2d4 days within the location it's bound to, fully healed. {Name} can be permanently destroyed only if someone sets right whatever prevents the spirit from resting.

abilities.name: Corrupting Gaze
abilities.description: {Name} stares at a creature it can see within 30 feet. The target takes {=1 + level / 2}d6 void damage with a DC {spelldc:high} basic Will save. A creature that fails its save is also stupefied 1 for 1 minute.

abilities.name: Draining Touch
abilities.description: With a touch, {name} attempts to drain a living creature's life force. It makes a ghostly hand Strike but deals no damage on a hit. Instead, the target becomes drained 1 for 1 day, and {name} regains {=max(1, level / 2)} HP.

abilities.name: Frightful Moan
abilities.description: {Name} laments its fate, forcing each living creature within 30 feet to attempt a DC {spelldc:high} Will save. On a failure, a creature becomes frightened 2 (or frightened 3 on a critical failure). On a success, a creature is temporarily immune to this ghost's frightful moan for 1 minute.

abilities.name: Inhabit Object
abilities.description: {Name} possesses an object of size Large or smaller within 20 feet, making it an animated object. This animated object's level can be no higher than {=level - 2}. If the target object is being held by a creature, the bearer can attempt a DC {spelldc:high} Will save to prevent the possession. This possession ends when the object is destroyed or the ghost leaves it. At this point, the ghost reappears in the object's square and can't Inhabit an Object again for 1d4 rounds.

abilities.name: Malevolent Possession
abilities.description: {Name} attempts to possess an adjacent corporeal creature (DC {spelldc:high}). This has the same effect as the _possession_ spell, except since the ghost doesn't have a physical body, it is unaffected by that restriction of the spell.

abilities.name: Telekinetic Assault
abilities.description: {Name} cries out in pain and anguish as small objects and debris fly about in a 30-foot emanation. Creatures in this area take {=1 + level / 2}d6 bludgeoning damage with a DC {spelldc:high} basic Reflex save.
